Tribal Archive / f23-bayreef-tribal
Pilot 2/19/2026 7:10 PM
In about 24 hours from now, one of you will become the 2nd person voted out of Tagtreevivor Open Season. Each of you must submit a vote to eliminate one of your fellow tribemates in your submissions channel by the deadline tomorrow. You may change your vote as many times you would like up until the deadline, but once the deadline passes your vote is locked, and can no longer be changed. The deadline to submit your vote is February 20th, 2026 7:00 PM (EST) 20 minutes before the deadline, we will begin live Tribal Council, where a member of Production will ask you questions about the game and your experience thus far. When the deadline hits, the live advantage period will begin. You will have 5 minutes to play any advantages you may have found. If you wish to play an advantage but will not be online at this time, you may pre-play it in your submissions channel and we will play it for you. To submit your vote, use any image-editing software to write or type the player's name on our parchment, then send it in your submissions channel. You may decorate your parchment, but make sure it is clear who you are voting for. If you have any questions, please ask (edited)
